<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
cast(x, dtype) -> 'core.SymbolicTensor'
```

Part of [`evoxc.ops`](/api/evoxc/ops/)

Cast to the given dtype.

## Parameters

- `x` — `SymbolicTensor` or Python scalar.

- `dtype` — Target numpy dtype or evoxc dtype constant.

## Returns

- `'core.SymbolicTensor'` — `SymbolicTensor` with `x`'s shape and exactly `dtype`.

## Raises

- `core.DTypeError` — `dtype` is not a valid numpy dtype.

- `core.TraceError` — no active trace; concrete `Tensor` operand.
